messages:
Keiko: pushed a new Figma for the A/B Variant Matrix UI: https://figma.com/file/variant-matrix (frames: 'Variant Matrix v1', 'Promote winner modal'). want feedback on labeling, colors, and keyboard nav.

Lina: nice start. main product ask: when multiple variants are live (A/B/C), the matrix should make it obvious which is experiment vs stable and which variant is the winner. current mock shows badges 'A', 'B' only  ambiguous. propose: show role label under variant name: 'experiment', 'stable', 'candidate', plus winner badge when finalized.

Ben: analytics view: show winner metrics inline (conversion, error rate, latency) with delta vs baseline. if a variant is statistically tied, we should surface a 'tie' state and recommend longer runtime or more traffic, not auto-promote. also provide a small 'Export results' CTA that downloads CSV with commit id, metrics, and sample size.

Raj: engineering note: rendering large matrices can get heavy. we should virtualize rows and allow column pinning (pin stable/overall metrics). also we can lazy-load metric sparklines on hover.

Sasha: accessibility items: DO NOT rely on color to distinguish variants. each variant column needs a clear textual legend: 'Variant A (blue stripe)'. For the matrix table, use semantic table markup (<table>, <thead>, <tbody>) and set aria-describedby on the table with a short summary 'Shows live A/B variants and key metrics'. Column headers should be buttons with aria-sort for sortable metrics.

Omar: about colors: pick a palette that remains distinct for up to 6 variants and add patterned fills (striped, dotted) for colorblind users. also ensure contrast for metric text on colored backgrounds.

Lina: keyboard navigation: arrow keys to move between cells, Enter to open variant details panel, and 'W' key to mark a variant as winner (when eligible). we should show a confirmation modal for 'Mark winner' with copy: 'Confirm mark vX as winner. This will promote vX to stable and route Y% immediately. Undo available for 30s.'

Sasha: screen reader behavior: when focus moves into the matrix announce context: 'Variant matrix. 3 variants. Use arrow keys to navigate cells. Press Enter for details.' For winner announcements, use aria-live="assertive": 'vB marked as winner; promoting to stable.' For tie state use polite announcement. avoid noisy updates while metrics stream in; debounce announcements to 1.5s.

Ben: microcopy for export: 'Export results (CSV)  includes commit, sample size, p-value, conversion delta'. For the Promote action, make the CTA explicit: 'Promote winner to stable'. avoid 'Promote' alone.

Raj: edge case: what if two variants share the same commit (A and C identical code but different configs)? UI should allow grouping identical commits and collapsing columns, and show a tooltip 'Same commit: abc123'. also add small commit chips under variant names.

Keiko: decisions so far: add role labels under variant names, winner badge + explicit 'Promote winner to stable' CTA, table semantics + aria-describedby, arrow-key nav + 'W' shortcut, export CSV with metrics, color + pattern fills for variants, debounce announcements 1.5s, 30s undo window in promote modal copy, support grouping identical commits. I'll update Figma and include a11y annotations.

Sasha: one more: ensure the modal has role=dialog and focus trap; return focus to the variant column header after close. Also include visually-hidden 'winner' text appended to the variant name for screen readers.

Lina: can we also show a small 'Recommend winner' flag from analytics if p-value < 0.05? Ben, can you spec the threshold and wording.

Ben: yes  I'll post a short doc outlining thresholds and the CSV columns. Recommend wording: 'Recommended winner (p < 0.05)'.

Keiko: great. I'll push an updated frame with grouped commits, patterns for variants, and the promote modal copy. please review tomorrow. :handshake:
